description: Lists the GDPR obligations of a company established in an EU or EEA country from a few facts (size, website and cookies, e-mail marketing, sensitive data, video surveillance, AI...). Deterministic rules: each obligation comes with its legal basis and a suggested search_law query for the official text. A fact left out is treated as unknown, except processors, which are assumed.

ai.description: True if it develops or uses AI systems that interact with or make decisions about people.

automated_decisions.description: True if it takes automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on people.

cctv.description: True if it uses video surveillance (CCTV).

country.description: Country where the company is established (ISO code of an EU or EEA country, e.g. FR, DE, ES, IT).

email_marketing.description: True if the company sends marketing e-mails or SMS to individuals.

evaluation_or_scoring.description: True if it evaluates or scores people (credit scoring, profiling, performance rating).

large_scale.description: True if the processing concerns a large number of people (large scale).

non_essential_cookies.description: True if the website or app uses non-essential cookies or trackers (analytics, advertising, social media pixels).

processors.description: True if providers process personal data on its behalf (hosting, SaaS, payroll, CRM). Assumed true if omitted.

public_sector.description: True if the organisation is a public authority or public body.

special_category_data.description: True if it processes special category data (health, biometrics, genetic data, religion, union membership, sex life or orientation, ethnic origin, political opinions).

systematic_monitoring.description: True if it systematically monitors people (online behaviour tracking, geolocation, profiling for advertising, CCTV of public areas).

transfers_outside_eea.description: True if personal data is sent to providers or entities outside the EEA (e.g. US SaaS).

vulnerable_people.description: True if it processes data of vulnerable people (children, patients, elderly people).

website.description: True if the company has a website or app.

name: gdpr_obligations
title: GDPR obligations of a company
